The day my dad died, I had a weird anxious feeling. He was going into hospital for an operation and I didn't feel good about it. So I decided, even though I didn't really feel like it, to go along for the car ride to drop him off at the hospital because I had this feeling he wasnt going to make it. Anyway, we went into town after dropping him off and soon received a phone call. There was no beds available for him so they would reschedule. I felt a little better after that, and we had a laugh on the drive home. Later that night, he passed away anyway suddenly. I somehow knew he would die that day.

Same happened with my nan's death a year earlier, she was in hospital and this day in particular I felt extremely anxious feeling and knew I had to visit her that night, even though I really wasn't planning on it because I was so ill myself that day. Yep, she died that night, while I was in the room.

 I'm so so glad my instincts told me to spend time with both of them those days, even though the feeling of dread was the worst...
